import math
min_difference = float('inf')
numerator = 0
denominator = 1

for i in range(1, int(limit) + 1):
    val = (a * i) / b
    floor_val = math.floor(val)
    diff_floor = abs((a / b) - (floor_val / i))
    if diff_floor < min_difference:
        min_difference = diff_floor
        numerator = floor_val
        denominator = i

    ceil_val = math.ceil(val)
    diff_ceil = abs((a / b) - (ceil_val / i))
    if diff_ceil < min_difference:
        min_difference = diff_ceil
        numerator = ceil_val
        denominator = i

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
